meta.governance: Campaign UX without payment. Forms are not stored on a server.

lede: Support the mission, join the movement, or ask to be a farmer we want to support. No payment is taken here. This website does not submit your details to BKS.
privacy: This website does not submit your details to BKS. The information is downloaded as a file to your device. If you choose to send that file to BKS, subsequent handling is outside this website.

paths.title: Farmer
paths.body: If you farm in West Bengal and want to be considered when a real intake exists, express interest. This is not enrolment and not a promise of ₹1 lakh.

paths.title: Supporter
paths.body: India and overseas supporters, including NRI friends of the Samaj, can register interest. There is no UPI, 80G, or donation receipt on this site.

paths.title: Volunteer
paths.body: No roster and no shift tool until intake is approved. You may still download a name-note. This website does not send it to BKS.

paths.title: Partner
paths.body: Organisations that may later walk with the mission. This is not a live sponsorship contract and not a payment.

form.intro: This form builds a file on your device. It does not pretend the Samaj has received it.
